verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at communityphone.org (HTTP 200) with an agent-readable summary. Many cited docs come from it, covering the Base hardware, setup, porting, plans, app and dashboard management, and business features, so an agent can be pointed at it for product understanding. Missing for 10: no deeper agent-oriented docs (e.g., llms-full.txt or API/integration references; OpenAPI paths all 404), content is marketing-level rather than actionable, and no independent corroboration of agent use.
